subject: cult-af-b
title: CULT.AF.B.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 123 (ALT(FT)II-17). CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From TR: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From IF-SPT: IST-F (isolated focus), whose line starts on a line from IF-SPT that ends at a dot with no label. From INDIV-TD: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From POL-DY: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From UNF-PI: EXP-CONT-2 (expansion condition (isolated focus)).
